Not the server (it judges a mapping's declared `sourceFormat`, as it should). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by objectui's own Import Wizard, which client-parses the file and sends JSON rows while naming a mapping that declares `sourceFormat: "csv"`; the platform path that covers it: the import door refuses the mismatch loudly (`400 MAPPING_FORMAT_MISMATCH`), so nothing is half-written; who reaches it: every console user who imports through a shipped CSV mapping (HotCRM's lead, account and contact mappings: 0 imported, per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188 F-07).
Thread-read: none
The card had no comment at this claim. It is filed under the maintainer's 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`).
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR touches `ImportWizard.tsx`. Fold-or-serial: queued objectui#13124 (the finished step's subtitle) shares `ImportWizard.tsx`. It is not folded, because it fails fold gate ①: a copy string, not the request format. It runs after this card.

Why `Clause-②: no`: the diff changes which request the wizard builds for a csv mapping, inside `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, using a request shape `@object-ui/types` already declares. No export, prop or accept set moves.
